================================================================================
   Smart Lost & Found System - Portable Windows Desktop Application
================================================================================

This package is completely self-contained and ready to run on any Windows laptop!

HIGHLIGHTS:
* NO Java Required: Bundled private Java runtime included in 'runtime'.
* NO MySQL Installation Required: Pre-configured with a shared Cloud MySQL database.
* REAL-TIME SYNC: All laptops connect to the same shared database. Any item posted
  on one laptop appears immediately on all other laptops!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO RUN:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Ensure your laptop is connected to the Internet (Wi-Fi or Mobile Hotspot).
2. Double-click 'SmartLostAndFound.exe'.
3. The application will open immediately!

You can also click "Register as New Student" on the login screen to create a new user.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATABASE CONFIGURATION:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The database settings are located in 'db.properties'.
It is currently configured with a live Clever Cloud MySQL instance.
If you ever want to switch back to local offline MySQL, edit 'db.properties':
  db.host=localhost
  db.password=YOUR_LOCAL_PASSWORD
================================================================================
